data.name: Eshraq
data.gender_notes: Eshraq is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The appearance of light during the early hours of the day, signifying hope and renewal. The name Eshraq carries the meaning “Dawn, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Eshraq usually hope their child will grow to embody dawn, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the spiritual light that illuminates the path to enlightenment
data.etymology: Eshraq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dawn, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eshraq total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: إشراق
in_arabic.meaning: إشراق يعني ظهور نور الشمس أو الإشعاع
in_arabic.long_meaning: إشراق هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'أشرق' الذي يعني ظهور نور الشمس أو الإشعاع. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط هذا الاسم ببداية يوم جديد ومليء بالأمل. وفي القرآن الكريم، نجد آيات تشير إلى إشراق نور الله تعالى. اسم إشراق يعبر عن الأمل والتجديد والضوء.

in_urdu.name: اشراق
in_urdu.meaning: اشراق کا مطلب ہے سورج کی روشنی یا انوار کا پھیلاؤ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اشراق ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سورج کی روشنی یا انوار کا پھیلاؤ۔ یہ نام اس فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'اشراق' یعنی سورج کا 뜨نا یا روشنی کا پھیلاؤ۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، یہ نام امید اور نئے آغاز کی علامت ہے۔ اشراق نام کی شخصیت کو روشن اور امیدوار سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इशराक
in_hindi.meaning: इशराक का अर्थ है सूरज की रोशनी या प्रकाश का फैलाव
in_hindi.long_meaning: इशराक एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सूरज की रोशनी या प्रकाश का फैलाव। यह नाम उस क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'इशराक' यानी सूरज का निकलना या प्रकाश का फैलाव। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम आशा और नए आरंभ की प्रतीक है। इशराक नाम के व्यक्ति को उज्ज्वल और आशावादी माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: اشراق
in_pashto.meaning: اشراق معنی دے دى لمرګ یا د رڼا خپریدل
in_pashto.long_meaning: اشراق د عربي ژبې يو نوم دى چى معنى يې دى لمرګ یا د رڼا خپریدل. دا نوم د هغه فعل نه اخستى شوى دى چى معنى يې دى 'اشراق' يعنى د لمر راخستل یا د رڼا خپریدل. په اسلامي کلتور کې، دا نوم د اميد او نوي پيل نښه ده. اشراق نومه شخصيت د روښانه او اميدوار په توګه ګڼل کېږي.

in_english.name: Eshraq
in_english.meaning: Eshraq means sunrise or radiant light
in_english.long_meaning: Eshraq is an Arabic name derived from the root 'ash-raqa', meaning to rise or to shine. It signifies the sunrise or the spreading of light. In Islamic tradition, Eshraq is associated with hope, renewal, and illumination. The name reflects positive attributes such as brightness, guidance, and spiritual enlightenment.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Eshraq" holds deep cultural significance in the Islamic world and is often used to refer to the beautiful, ethereal light that graces the eastern horizon as the sun rises. This phenomenon is celebrated in various Islamic traditions, and the term "Eshraq" embodies the essence of this natural wonder.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Eshraq" is believed to symbolize hope and renewal. Just as the sun rises each day to bring light to the world, "Eshraq" signifies the divine promise of a new beginning and an opportunity for personal growth and enlightenment. The name is also associated with the remembrance of Allah, as the first light of the day is a reminder of His presence and power. Ultimately, "Eshraq" represents the dynamic interplay between the natural world and the divine, reminding us of the beauty and wonder of creation, and the boundless mercy and grace of the Creator.
